name: Forgotten-Movies
description: Forgotten Movies keeps Plex requests from gathering dust. It watches Overseerr for requests that have been fulfilled, checks Tautulli to see whether the requester actually watched them, and sends a friendly email reminder when something has been available for too long.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Path to the application data folder

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Random secret key for Flask sessions

variables.name: Request Portal URL
variables.description: Base URL to your request portal (e.g., https://overseerr.example.com)

variables.name: Tautulli - URL
variables.description: API URL to your Tautulli instance

variables.name: Tautulli - API Key
variables.description: API Key for your Tautulli instance

variables.name: Overseerr - URL
variables.description: API URL to your Overseerr instance

variables.name: Overseerr - API Key
variables.description: API Key for your Overseerr instance

variables.name: Overseerr - Number of Requests
variables.description: Number of completed requests to fetch from Overseerr

variables.name: TMDb - API Key
variables.description: API Key for The Movie Database (TMDb)

variables.name: Email - SMTP Server
variables.description: SMTP server address for sending emails

variables.name: Email - SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP server port

variables.name: Email - SMTP Encryption
variables.description: SMTP encryption method

variables.name: Email - SMTP Username
variables.description: Username for SMTP authentication

variables.name: Email - From Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the 'From' field of the email

variables.name: Email - From Address
variables.description: Email address used in the 'From' field

variables.name: Email - Password
variables.description: Password for the email account

variables.name: Email - BBC
variables.description: Optional BCC email address

variables.name: Email - Admin Name
variables.description: What name in the email do you want shown

variables.name: Processing - Days Until Expired
variables.description: Request age, in days, to trigger an email reminder

variables.name: Processing - Days Until Expired Human-Readable
variables.description: Human readable version DAYS_SINCE_REQUEST for email body

variables.name: Processing - Hours Between Emails
variables.description: Minimum hours between reminder emails to the same user

variables.name: Processing - Job Interval
variables.description: Interval, in seconds, between checking for forgotten movies

variables.name: Processing - Startup Delay
variables.description: Delay, in seconds, before the first check for forgotten movies after container start

variables.name: Tautulli - Max Number of New Metadata Requests
variables.description: Maximum new Seerr requests per run that can ask Tautulli for title metadata when Seerr did not provide a title (default 50).

variables.name: Tautulli - Max Number of Recent Unknown Metadata Requests
variables.description: Maximum existing unknown-title requests per run that can ask Tautulli for title metadata/watch history (default 30)

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level for the application

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable or disable debug mode

variables.name: Debug Email
variables.description: Email address to send to when in debug mode

variables.name: Debug Max Email Count
variables.description: Maximum number of emails to send in debug mode

variables.name: Disable Scheduler
variables.description: Disable the internal scheduler, avoid hitting APIs or triggering emails
